notes: v0.85.0 (versionCode 122) — CI android-release run 39663731877 from main at 07ae9931. ONBOARDING THAT IS ACTUALLY REACHED, THE REFERENCE AI TILES, A REAL MODEL DETAILS PAGE. (1) THE START DESTINATION only read the session flag, so signing in (or a restored session) dropped the user straight onto Home and the welcome pages were never seen. It now checks SessionStore.isOnboarded first, so the three welcome pages and the capability setup are part of the normal flow. (2) THE FIRST-RUN MODEL CONSENT no longer covers onboarding: the dialog was composed above the whole app and painted over the welcome pages as soon as the device survey resolved. It now composes inside the nav host and only outside the session gate. (3) AI INTELLIGENCE matches the reference layout: model source as a 2-up and reasoning effort as a 3-up of tall tiles (icon, title, one supporting line, check when selected) instead of stacked rows. The effort tiles are the same flash/thinking/auto switch the chat header writes. (4) MODEL DETAILS: a real page for the on-device engine — device tier, measured download size, minimum RAM, parameter count, four honest capabilities, engine/file rows and a Download or Use-this-model action that calls the existing consent flow. (5) CHAT SURFACES: the "…" sheet is the reference list — Share, Rename, Chat Details, Export, Clear, Delete, Cancel — and Chat Details opens a page with measured stats (messages, span, response style, model, mode). Home opens on a glass resume card for the last thread, with markdown stripped to prose. (6) TYPE: the greeting is a calm 32pt medium on both platforms, matching the reference, instead of a display-weight headline. (7) iOS: the same options sheet and Chat Info sheet, plus the fourteen-scene SwiftUI artwork port; the app target builds, and the UI test that kept the iOS gate red now navigates from Home into a chat before looking for the composer (verification in flight). Carried from 0.84.0: the 540-icon parser fix (line-based glyphs were blank), the illustration set, and per-datum taps on every advanced chart. Verified: android-app 39663724799 (green), android-screens 39663728214 (green, screenshots in download/qa-0.85-*.png), android-release 39663731877 (green, this APK).
knownLimitations: iOS is compile-verified by ios-native device+simulator builds; there is no iOS screenshot harness.
The artwork is vector-only by design — no raster illustrations ship.
Charts read out one datum at a time; there is no multi-select or pinning.
No billing backend: the Subscription page states that honestly instead of showing a price.
